rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=40, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=0, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=120, train_n=0, rationale=iter-5 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon vs reused Mayo DDPM v4 ckpt (ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, NO retrain). ONE HYPOTHESIS KNOB: recon_sample_steps (T, the DDIM reverse-step count) 25->40; val_n 214->120 evenly-spaced is the BUDGET-SIZING mechanism (box 5), NOT a hypothesis variable. BASE = iter-2 BEST non-collapsed config (eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_dcstep_every=0 = PURE SOFT DPS with NO hard-CG, recon_eta_clamp=false). Did NOT base off iter-3 (T=32 at eta=5/every=0 was slightly DOWN 0.396->0.387) or iter-4 (hard-DC every=5 COLLAPSED to 0.0553 -- do NOT switch to hard-DC). TRAJECTORY (val=214 L277, 321px FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T=25/eta=30/every=0 SSIM 0.3688/hr0/PSNR10.55; iter-2 eta30->5 SSIM 0.3960/hr0/PSNR11.25 (BEST); iter-3 T25->32 SSIM 0.3869/hr0 (slightly DOWN at eta=5/every=0); iter-4 every0->5 hard-DC SSIM 0.0553 (COLLAPSE). KEY SIGNAL the unconstrained iter-3/4 authors OVER-WEIGHTED: the unconstrained T-probe stopped at T=32 (only +7 steps) and read flat, prematurely filing prior-mismatch. The CONSTRAINED SIBLING REFUTED that: at its working point T28->T40 lifted SSIM 0.478->0.665 MONOTONICALLY (+0.187, PSNR +5.8dB), and earlier T25->28 lifted 0.394->0.478. T is the STRONGEST live lever once the rest of the config sits at a working point; the 25-step low-T DDIM schedule is too COARSE for the FBP-initialized iterate to relax onto the sino-consistent mode. eta is EXHAUSTED (30->5 only +0.027) and I do NOT move it off the iter-2 working point; I do NOT switch to hard-DC (collapsed). FAILURE MODE (numbers): the recon sits 0.396 vs the 0.81 FBP floor; the coarse 25-step reverse schedule + pure-soft DPS cannot pull the FBP init onto the measurement manifold in so few steps. HYPOTHESIS: if the constrained-siblings T-climb mechanism transfers to the unconstrained soft-DPS path, T 25->40 (+15-step, 1.6x finer reverse schedule) lifts SSIM meaningfully above iter-2 0.3960 -- predicted 0.50-0.60 (a monotone continuation toward the floor). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays <=0.42 (flat vs iter-2 0.396) at T=40, T has SATURATED on the soft-DPS unconstrained path -> the eta AND T levers are both exhausted -> FILE THE DIFFUSION-PRIOR-MISMATCH VERDICT for the unconstrained variant (Mayo v4 DDPM globally faithful but not conditionally faithful under soft DPS, mirroring the breast-DDPM hr=0 structural verdict); unconstrained best stays iter-2 (SSIM 0.396, hr 0). BUDGET (HARD 20-min=1200s wall): per-step-per-slice constant ~0.162 s (iter-2 868.33/214/25=0.1623; iter-3 1103.8/214/32=0.1612 -- clean linear in TxVAL_N). T=40 x val_n=120 = 40*120*0.162 = 778s = 13.0 min < 1200s wall (~420s headroom). T=40 x val_n=214 would be 1387s=23.1min (BLOWS the wall) -> val_n=120 is the budget mechanism that unlocks the T test, evenly-spaced across the 214-slice L277 volume (protocol-sanctioned when val_n<214; matches the constrained iter-5 basis for comparability). val=120 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False).
